title: Why the Ganges River Is Holy

tiktok.title: WHY THE GANGES IS HOLY
tiktok.hook: A RIVER THAT IS A GODDESS?!

lines.say: For millions of Hindus, this river isn't just water. It's a goddess!
The Ganges flows from the Himalaya mountains all the way across India to the sea.
In Hindu belief, the river is the goddess Ganga, who came down from heaven to earth.
People believe her water washes away wrongdoings, so pilgrims come to bathe in it.
The holiest city on the river is Varanasi, one of the oldest cities in the world that people still live in.
Every evening there's a ceremony with fire, songs and floating lamps, called Ganga Aarti.
Would you like to see it? Tell me in the comments!
